content.overview: Five people sit closely together on a large cream sectional sofa in a bright living room. Two children and three adults are smiling or laughing while warm daylight enters from the left.

evidence.label: People
evidence.detail: Five visible people sit tightly together: two young girls, one woman, one man in the center, and another man on the right. Exact kinship and ages for the older people are not visually provable.

evidence.label: Young girl — left
evidence.detail: Very curly dark-brown hair; cream/off-white long-sleeve top; blue jeans; bare feet. She sits partly across the woman’s lap/side, looks upward toward her, and smiles or laughs.

evidence.label: Adult woman — left-center
evidence.detail: Medium-brown shoulder-length softly wavy hair; broad laughing smile; cream chunky-knit long-sleeve sweater; blue jeans. Her arms and hands visibly support the left child.

evidence.label: Adult man — center
evidence.detail: Short dark hair; close beard; light-blue long-sleeve button-up shirt with folded collar and front buttons; tan/beige trousers. He sits centrally, smiles/laughs, and has an arm/hand positioned to support the child on his right.

evidence.label: Young girl — center-right
evidence.detail: Full curly dark hair; cream long-sleeve knit top; blue jeans; bare feet. She sits between the two male figures, leans inward, and laughs.

evidence.label: Man — right
evidence.detail: Dark face-framing braids; broad smile; pale-blue long-sleeve button-up shirt; warm brown/tan trousers; one bare foot visible. He leans inward with an arm and hand close around the child beside him.

evidence.label: Sofa & textiles
evidence.detail: Large cream sectional sofa with a left chaise, cream textured/knitted cushions, and a mustard-yellow accent pillow.

evidence.label: Window & light
evidence.detail: A large white-framed window stands at left beside a sheer cream curtain. Strong natural daylight enters from that side and creates a warm golden interior tone.

evidence.label: Shelves & décor
evidence.detail: White floating shelves hold neutral-colored books, small framed photographs, a woven decorative object, and a potted plant.

evidence.label: Fireplace & mantel
evidence.detail: A white fireplace with a dark opening occupies the right background. The mantel holds framed photographs, taper candles, a large cream candle, and a potted plant; several pillar candles sit inside the fireplace opening.

evidence.label: Floor & plants
evidence.detail: A large leafy floor plant stands in a woven basket planter at far right. Medium-brown wooden flooring and a neutral coarse woven rug are visible below.

evidence.label: Visible action / body language
evidence.detail: The five people sit close together, several smile or laugh simultaneously, the children are visibly supported by adults, and most bodies angle inward toward the group.

evidence.label: Emotion cue vs inference
evidence.detail: Smiles, laughter, touch, close seating, and inward body angles are visible facts. Comfort, affection, or a specific family relationship are interpretations rather than directly visible facts.

micro: Person-by-person scan: separate hair/face, clothing, lower body, hands/arms, posture, and contact so each person can be described precisely.
Physical proximity is a strong visible cue: five people occupy a compact section of the sofa and several bodies touch or overlap.
The two children are visibly supported by nearby older people, but the still image does not establish exact parentage, sibling order, or a complete family tree.
The living room adds useful object vocabulary: cream upholstery, textured cushions, a mustard pillow, floating shelves, books, framed photographs, candles, plants, wood flooring, and a woven rug.
Warm daylight visibly enters from the left. The photo supports daytime and warm illumination, but not an exact clock time or outside weather.
Keep emotion evidence-coded: smiles/laughter and physical contact are visible; comfort, affection, and bonding are cautious interpretations.

inference.high: The shared laughter, inward body angles, and repeated physical contact may suggest warmth, comfort, and a strong sense of connection.
inference.medium: The group may be a family or extended family. The children are physically supported by nearby adults, several people have arms around one another, and everyone sits very close together. Exact kinship cannot be confirmed from the photograph alone.
inference.low: Someone in the group may have told a joke, one of the children may have done something amusing, or the group could be reacting to a photographer or another person outside the frame.

timeline.before: They may have gathered on the sofa to talk or relax; the activity immediately before this frame is not visible.
timeline.now: Five people are sitting closely together on the cream sectional, smiling or laughing while the two children are supported by nearby older people.
timeline.next: They may continue talking or relaxing together, but the next action is not visible in this single frame.

content.guardrail: State the five people, clothing, seating positions, visible touch, laughter, sofa, window light, shelves, fireplace, plants, photographs, candles, rug, and wooden floor as facts. A family/extended-family reading may be offered as a supported possibility, but exact kinship, a specific joke, a special occasion, ownership, wealth, and exact time are not established.
content.story: CREATIVE EXTENSION — NOT A VISUAL FACT. Perhaps this is a relaxed family gathering and someone has just told a story that makes everyone laugh at once. The children may be sitting with parents, relatives, or family friends. The family label and conversation are imagined; the close seating, support, and laughter are visible.

grammar.title: Collective nouns and subject–verb agreement
grammar.explainer: Use singular agreement when a collective group is treated as one unit and plural agreement when the subject is people or members. Keep the photographed group relationship-neutral unless outside context gives exact family roles.
examples: A group of five people is sitting on the sofa.
The people are sitting close together.
A family is a singular collective noun in common American English usage.

models.A1–A2: Five people are sitting together on a cream sofa. They are smiling and laughing. Two children are sitting between three adults. The room has a fireplace, pillows, books, photographs, and plants. Warm light comes from the left window.
models.B1–B2: A group of five people is sitting closely together on a cream sectional sofa in a bright living room. A woman in a cream sweater supports the girl beside her, while the man in the center and the man on the right sit close to the second child. Several people are laughing. Framed photographs, plants, a fireplace, cushions, and warm window light fill the room.
models.C1–C2: The strongest visual feature of this living-room scene is physical proximity. Five people occupy a compact section of the cream sofa, the two children are physically supported by older people beside them, and several bodies angle inward toward the group. Cream knitwear, pale-blue shirts, warm wood, and a mustard cushion create a soft palette, while framed photographs, shelves, candles, and plants add dense domestic detail. The visible evidence supports a close, cheerful interaction; exact kinship remains outside what the image alone can prove.

runtime.idleNote: Use singular agreement for family/group as one unit and plural agreement for people or family members.
runtime.detectedNote: A family/group agreement form was detected. Check whether the subject is singular collective or plural members.
runtime.safeNote: Subject–verb agreement matches the preferred American English pattern for this lesson.
runtime.unsafeNote: Agreement mismatch: family/group as one unit is singular; people/family members are plural.

speaking.30: Give 4–5 simple sentences: identify the room, the five people, one visible action, and two objects. Use only details you can point to.
speaking.60: Describe the group from left to right, then add the sofa, window light, shelves, fireplace, and one cautious inference using seems, may, might, or could.
speaking.90: Give a full reconstruction: overview → people → clothing → interaction → sofa/textiles → background décor → plants/floor → light → one cautious inference. Finish by naming one thing the image cannot prove.

listener.label: Living-Room Listener
listener.sub: Help a listener rebuild the five-person living-room scene from concrete details.

prompts.label: OPEN THE SCENE
prompts.prompt: Who is sitting in the foreground, where are they, and what are they doing?
prompts.hint: Start with five people + cream sectional sofa + laughing.

prompts.label: DISTINGUISH THE PEOPLE
prompts.prompt: Add two clothing or position details that help distinguish the woman, the two men, and the two girls.
prompts.hint: Try cream sweater, light blue shirts, or barefoot children.

prompts.label: MAP THE ROOM
prompts.prompt: Where are the window, fireplace, framed photographs, plants, and mustard cushion?
prompts.hint: Use on the left, on the right, behind the group, or on the sofa.

prompts.label: DESCRIBE CONTACT
prompts.prompt: What visible body-language details show that the group is physically close?
prompts.hint: Use sit close together, hold/support, arms around, or lean inward.

prompts.label: RECONSTRUCT
prompts.prompt: Give a connected description that lets me picture the people, sofa, room, light, and shared action.
prompts.hint: Keep exact family roles separate from what the image proves.

detective.label: Relationship Evidence Detective
detective.sub: Separate the visible five-person group from supported social inference and unsupported exact-kinship claims.

prompts.label: VISIBLE FACTS
prompts.prompt: State two facts that are directly visible in the room.
prompts.hint: Use people count, seating, laughter, clothing, window, fireplace, or plants.

prompts.label: SUPPORTED INFERENCE
prompts.prompt: Give one cautious inference about how comfortable the people seem and name the clues.
prompts.hint: Use close seating, touch, inward posture, and laughter.

prompts.label: RELATIONSHIP EVIDENCE
prompts.prompt: What does the photograph actually prove about how the people relate to one another?
prompts.hint: It shows close seating, touch, support, inward posture, and laughter; exact kinship is unknown.

prompts.label: DRAW THE GUARDRAIL
prompts.prompt: Name one family-tree or occasion claim the image cannot prove.
prompts.hint: Exact mother/father assignments, sibling order, or a birthday are unknown.

prompts.label: REPAIR CERTAINTY
prompts.prompt: Repair: “The woman is definitely the mother of both girls.”
prompts.hint: Keep the visible support and closeness, but remove exact family-role certainty.

story.label: Living-Room Story Relay
story.sub: Extend the domestic moment through Before → Now → Next without inventing a documented family history.

prompts.label: START WITH NOW
prompts.prompt: Describe the visible present moment on the sofa.
prompts.hint: Five people are sitting close and laughing.

prompts.label: STEP BACK
prompts.prompt: What may have happened just before they sat like this?
prompts.hint: They may have gathered to talk, relax, or take a photo.

prompts.label: MOVE FORWARD
prompts.prompt: What might happen next in an ordinary home setting?
prompts.hint: They might keep talking, take a photo, or move to another activity.

prompts.label: TIE TO A CLUE
prompts.prompt: Which visible clue makes your story extension plausible?
prompts.hint: Use the sofa, close seating, laughter, household objects, or warm daylight.

prompts.label: THREE-SENTENCE RELAY
prompts.prompt: Retell Before → Now → Next in three connected, cautious sentences.
prompts.hint: Before they may have… Now they are… Next they might…
